description: This Java source file defines the class CachedMessageSource, which implements an in-memory, mutable message source for handling localized presentation messages, including methods for adding, removing, retrieving, and merging messages.

classes.name: CachedMessageSource
classes.description: A class that provides an in-memory, mutable implementation of a message source for localized presentation messages, supporting adding, removing, retrieving, and merging messages.

methods.name: addPresentation
methods.description: Adds a PresentationMessage to the localized map, creating a new locale entry if necessary.

methods.name: getLocales
methods.description: Returns a collection of all locales for which messages are stored.

methods.name: getPresentations
methods.description: Retrieves all PresentationMessages stored across all locales.

methods.name: removePresentation
methods.description: Removes a specific PresentationMessage from the storage based on its locale and code.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges messages from another MutableMessageSource into this source.

methods.name: getPresentation
methods.description: Fetches a specific PresentationMessage by key and locale.

methods.name: getPresentationsInLocale
methods.description: Returns all PresentationMessages for a specific locale.
